messages:
Noah (PM): Quick sync — RetailCo asked for an "Executive Spend Story" in Console they can hand to their CFO. They need a concise narrative: what changed, why cost moved, and 1-2 representative traces. My MVP idea: a single-card "Spend Story" that shows top delta routes (dollars + pct), a short root-cause tag (traffic | model | params | error), an overlay showing recent deploys/rollouts, and up to 2 trace envelopes per flagged route. Keep it audit-friendly (no PII).

Kei (Eng): Love the deploy overlay idea — that helps tie cost jumps to model/rollout changes. Implementation notes: route aggregation + delta detection (compare past-7d vs prior-7d), a small event bus to pull rollout metadata, and a trace-envelope emitter that includes {trace_id, route, error_code, token_summary, model_hint}. Envelopes only when route delta > threshold.

Sana (SRE): Ops constraints: default envelope sampling 0.2% for all orgs, retention 72h, per-org envelope quota and an auto-throttle that reduces sampling if envelope/sec > baseline*3. Need an incident toggle in Console to cut all envelopes immediately. Also we should redline any UI action that requests raw traces (flows to SE).

Isha (Data): Cost-estimate approach: delta_cost = delta_tokens * model_unit_cost(profile) + delta_calls * avg_overhead. We'll compute a "root-cause tagger" via heuristics: if model profile changed recently -> tag model; if tokens per call increased -> tag tokenization; if error rate increased -> tag errors. Show a confidence score per tag. For CFO view, show the top driver (e.g., +$23k from token growth).

Bea (UX): Keep the Executive card minimal: headline number (+$) with colored delta, 3 bullet drivers (tokens, model, errors) with small percent bars, and a tiny timeline with markers for deploys. For traces, show 2 one-line envelopes per route with a "Request raw traces" button that opens a controlled request workflow. Tooltip copy: "Estimates are for diagnostics, not billing."

Sam (Solutions): Customer ask: RetailCo wants ability to export the Spend Story slide as PNG/PDF for their exec pack. Can we add an export action in MVP? Even if it's a static snapshot, they'd love it.

Kei (Eng): We can add export as a frontend feature once data surfaces are stable. Backend plan: small aggregation job runs every 10m writing top deltas to a derived-metrics table. Trace envelopes go via feature-flagged pubsub topic. Config snippet: 
```yaml
console:
  spend_story:
    enabled: true
    delta_window_days: 7
    envelope:
      default_sampling: 0.002  # 0.2%
      retention_days: 3
      per_org_quota: 5000/day
      max_payload_bytes: 600
    deploy_overlay: true
```

Sana (SRE): Add alerts: `console.spend_story.envelope_surge` (threshold: org_envelopes/sec > baseline*3) and `console.spend_story.p95_regress` (p95 > 1.2x baseline). Also require a canary rollout with no measurable p95 regression before wider enablement.

Isha (Data): UX microcopy for confidence: "Root cause tags are inferred heuristics with confidence score; use as investigative leads." We'll also surface a small CI (e.g., +/- 15%).

Noah (PM): Launch acceptance checklist (MVP): 1) Executive Spend Story card shows top-5 delta routes with dollar deltas + root-cause tag; 2) Deploy overlay shows recent model/infra rollouts; 3) Up to 2 trace envelopes per flagged route visible (no PII); 4) Per-org sampling controls + retention config; 5) Alerts and incident kill-switch in place; 6) Pilot with RetailCo completed and p95 baseline validated; 7) Export-to-PDF button (optional stretch). Owners: Kei -> backend + trace hook, Isha -> delta algorithm + tags, Bea -> UI + export UX, Sana -> alerts + kill switch, Noah -> pilot coordination.

LambdaBot: Created alert templates `console.spend_story.envelope_surge` and `console.spend_story.p95_regress`.
